title: Travel Agents: Taiwan — Player Aid
subtitle: On your turn: do ONE action · then trim your Larder to 7

sections.heading: Do ONE action
lines: VISIT (here): flip 3 from this region's market — the event fires by scope, keep 2 ingredients (Big Eater 大胃王 keeps 3).
CONVENIENCE STORE (anywhere): flip 1 from any region's market — take the ingredient, or the event fires.

TRAVEL: move 1 region (HSR = 北↔南); flip 1 on arrival (event whiffs). Then GROW: 1 follower, supply → your board. (Homebody 媽寶 draws 2 from the region she LEFT; Globetrotter 阿嬤 reaches ANY region, tiring 1 follower to supply.)
PROMOTE (here): place up to 2 followers FROM YOUR BOARD onto face-up stall(s) here — stacked or spread, in full view.

BRIBE A STALL (here): win it if you hold STRICTLY MORE followers on it than every rival (Big Brother 大哥 wins ties) + pay its ingredients − your region discounts (no follower cost). It joins your tour + may complete a Booking. Your followers come HOME to your board; each loser's scatter to their OWN supply. Leave the slot empty.
LINE UP A BOOKING: take 1 from the face-up row, then refill. Your Bookings are your whole score (成團 completed / 取消 cancelled).
